notes:
Run each prompt in a fresh agent session WITH the skill installed, against a WRITABLE COPY of the fixture (the eval runner copies files[] into a fresh temp workdir per run; agents must never write into evals/fixtures/ source). Grade by reading the resulting workdir + the transcript; never grade the author's own memory.

Headless scope gap (documented, not silently skipped): the runner has no git repo and no authenticated `gh`, so the live paths — `git describe --tags`, `gh pr list`, annotated tag creation, `git push`, `gh release create --draft` — are NOT exercised here. The fixtures supply a pre-fetched merged-prs.md, which is exactly the skill's documented fallback when `gh` is unavailable. The live git/gh path is deferred until a harness can provision a real remote; when it can, add a `deferred: true` eval that runs setup against a throwaway git repo and asserts the tag. What IS tested: version-bump correctness (minor / major / none), changelog rewrite, release-notes draft, and the approval gate.

evals.prompt: time to cut the next release of the app under fixtures/release-minor/. there's no gh auth in this sandbox, so use the pre-fetched merged-prs.md sitting next to package.json for the changes since the last tag (v1.3.1) instead of gh pr list. bump the version, update the changelog, and get the release notes ready — but don't tag or push anything until I've looked at it.
expected_behavior: Bumps package.json from 1.3.1 to 1.4.0 (feat -> MINOR; no breaking change present)
Rewrites CHANGELOG.md: moves Unreleased content into '## [1.4.0] - <UTC date>' with Added and Fixed entries carrying PR numbers (#214, #218), and re-opens an empty Unreleased heading
Drafts release notes (writes RELEASE_NOTES.md when gh is unavailable) for v1.4.0
Does NOT create a tag, push, or publish a GitHub release — stops at the approval gate and says approval is required

evals.prompt: cut a release for fixtures/release-major/. no gh here — the changes since v1.4.2 are in merged-prs.md next to package.json. do the version bump, changelog, and notes, then stop for my sign-off before anything hits the remote.
expected_behavior: Bumps package.json from 1.4.2 to 2.0.0 (feat! / BREAKING CHANGE -> MAJOR)
Records the change in CHANGELOG.md under a dated '## [2.0.0]' heading
Does NOT tag, push, or publish — stops at the approval gate

evals.prompt: can we ship a release of fixtures/no-changes/? last tag is v1.0.0 and the merged PRs since then are in merged-prs.md beside package.json. just bump whatever needs bumping and get the notes ready.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the changes are only docs/chore/ci/style — no user-visible change — and reports 'nothing to release' instead of bumping
Leaves package.json at 1.0.0 (does not bump only to bump)
Does NOT create a tag, changelog release entry, or release notes
